verses.text: "What a help you are to someone with no power! How you have saved the arm with no strength!
What great advice you have given to someone without wisdom! How much good sense you have shown!
Who helped you say these words? Whose spirit spoke through you?
The spirits of the dead tremble, those beneath the waters and all who live there.
The grave lies open before God. The place of destruction has no cover.
He spreads out the northern skies over empty space and hangs the earth on nothing.
He wraps up the waters in his thick clouds, and the clouds do not burst under their weight.
He covers the face of the full moon by spreading his clouds over it.
He draws the horizon on the face of the waters, the boundary between light and darkness.
The pillars of heaven shake and are amazed when he speaks sharply.
By his power he calmed the sea. By his wisdom he struck down the monster Rahab.
By his breath the skies became clear. His hand pierced the gliding snake.
And these are only the edges of what he does. We hear only a small whisper of him. Who could ever understand the thunder of his power?"
